normal.name: Rivkah
normal.text: I really want to make a zine or collection of zines that are focused on games I played in my childhood. A love letter to them. Maybe even reviews of them, but by an adult version of myself in conversation with what I remember loving about them from childhood.

normal.name: Laura Innis
normal.text: I feel stupid mourning a game developer at the same time, but I feel like we’ll never see stories that good again. NWN was the first proper PC game I remember playing through. Nothing came close to #DragonAge for me.

normal.name: Josh
normal.text: My mom had lots of PC games. And sometimes I would just pick one up and put it in the drive and try it. Once I did that with a Jeopardy game. And during the player setup, it said something like SEX? [M or F]: ☐ Obviously I had no idea what any of that meant, I was like 4 years old or something.

normal.name: Neo Retro Union
normal.text: Can we all agree that obscure Taiwanese MS-DOS games need some love as well? For those wondering who Madiesha is, she's the Romanian leotard-clad gymnast from a forgotten Taiwanese MS-DOS fighting game called Tough Guy. #Costober #MSDOS

normal.text: Daily Question from author Karen L West. What was your first ever video game? Oh, dear. I’m afraid this answer is going to date me! 😂 Commodore 64: a little game where a ball bounced back and forth across the screen. Think of a very rough version of Pong. What was your first game?
